BRIGHTWELL LABS, INC.
NOTICE OF RESTRICTED STOCK UNIT AWARD

Participant: Riley Okafor
Date of Grant: March 4, 2027
The Company hereby grants you 12,000 restricted stock units (RSUs) under the 2025 Equity Incentive Plan.
The RSUs vest over four years, with a one-year cliff, and vest quarterly after the cliff.
Each RSU represents the right to receive one share of Common Stock upon settlement.
Settlement occurs only on a qualifying liquidity event.
